name: mxfp8_jagged_scale_layout
description: Per-expert jagged scale layout for MX-FP8 variable-K grouped GEMM — supports arbitrary per-expert M_g (including 0-token and giant experts) without padding.
preconditions: MX-FP8 wgrad kernel reducing along variable-M per expert
tl.dot_scaled with e4m3 operands + e8m0 scales, GROUP_K=32
steps: Compute scale_offs[G+1] = cumsum of ceil(M_g / 32) per expert on GPU
Total scale columns = scale_offs[-1] (one .item() sync is cheap)
Quant kernel grid = (total_scale_cols, cdiv(L, BLOCK_L)) — NOT (G, max_sg, L) which wastes dispatches on unbalanced shapes
Block-to-expert lookup via torch.repeat_interleave(arange(G), sg_per_group) — passed as a small i32 tensor
In wgrad kernel: replace 'ms_start = m_start // 32' with 'ms_start = tl.load(scale_offs_ptr + group_idx)'
Tail-iter scale mask uses ceil-division: 'mask_ks = rks < (tail_m + GROUP_K - 1) // GROUP_K' (not //)
Zero-init fp8 output tensor so partial last scale groups have zero fp8 for rows past M_g
expected_impact: Correct on any per-expert M_g. +8% step on real unbalanced MoE trace (vs pad-to-32 approach) at gpt_oss_20B shape. Eliminates pad buffer + detect-if-unbalanced branch.
decision_rules: Use when any M_g % 32 != 0 is possible in the workload. Real MoE traces always have some misaligned experts.
